author: J. C. Ryle
title_tet: Ó Moris Foun Ona Ka Lae?
subtitle_en: "Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God" (John 3:3)
subtitle_tet: "Se ema ida la moris foun, nia labele haree Maromak nia reinu" (João 3:3)

cards.section_heading_tet: Introdusaun - Pergunta Importante Liu Iha Moris
cards.scripture_en: "Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God" (John 3:3).
cards.scripture_tet: "Se ema ida la moris foun, nia labele haree Maromak nia reinu" (João 3:3).
cards.body_en: This is one of life’s most important questions. Jesus Christ said, “Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God” (John 3:3). It is not enough to reply, “I belong to the church; I suppose I’m a Christian.” Thousands of nominal Christians show none of the signs of being born again which the Scriptures have given us—many listed in the First Epistle of John.
cards.body_tet: Ida-ne'e mak pergunta ida ne'ebé importante liu iha moris. Jesus Kristu dehan, "Se ema ida la moris foun, nia labele haree Maromak nia reinu" (João 3:3). La to'o atu hatán, "Ha'u pertense ba igreja; ha'u hanoin ha'u sarani ida." Ema sarani rihun ba rihun ne'ebé naran de'it la hatudu sinál ruma kona-ba moris foun ne'ebé Eskritura fó mai ita—barak liu hakerek iha 1 João.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Church membership or nominal profession is not enough; true spiritual regeneration must be shown by biblical marks.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Sai membru igreja ka konfisaun naran de'it la to'o; rejenerasaun espirituál ne'ebé loos tenke hatudu liuhosi sinál bíbliku sira.

cards.section_heading_tet: Sinál Dahuluk - La Halo Sala Ho Habitualmente
cards.scripture_en: "Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin" (1 John 3:9). "Whosoever is born of God sinneth not" (1 John 5:18). "If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves" (1 John 1:8).
cards.scripture_tet: "Ema hotu ne'ebé moris husi Maromak la halo sala" (1 João 3:9). "Ema hotu ne'ebé moris husi Maromak la halo nafatin sala" (1 João 5:18). "Se ita dehan katak ita la iha sala, ita bosok ita-nia aan rasik" (1 João 1:8).
cards.body_en: First of all, John wrote: “Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin” (1 John 3:9). “Whosoever is born of God sinneth not” (5:18). A person who has been born again, or regenerated, does not habitually commit sin. He no longer sins with his heart and will and whole inclination. There was probably a time when he did not think about whether his actions were sinful or not, and he did not always feel grieved after doing evil. There was no quarrel between him and sin; they were friends. But the true Christian hates sin, flees from it, fights against it, considers it his greatest plague, resents the burden of its presence, mourns when he falls under its influence, and longs to be completely delivered from it. Sin no longer pleases him; it has become a horrible thing which he hates. However, he cannot eliminate its presence within him. If he said that he had no sin, he would be lying (1 John 1:8). But he can say that he hates sin and that the great desire of his soul is not to commit sin at all.
cards.body_tet: Dahuluk liu, João hakerek: "Ema hotu ne'ebé moris husi Maromak la halo sala" (1 João 3:9). "Ema hotu ne'ebé moris husi Maromak la halo nafatin sala" (5:18). Ema ida ne'ebé moris foun ona, ka rejeneradu, la halo sala ho habitualmente. Nia la halo sala tan ho ninia laran, hakarak no inklinasaun tomak. Karik iha tempu ida ne'ebé nia la hanoin kona-ba ninia hahalok sira sala ka lae, no nia la sente laran-triste sempre hafoin halo aat. La iha funu entre nia no sala; sira mak belun. Maibé sarani loos odi sala, halai sees husi ida-ne'e, funu hasoru ida-ne'e, konsidera ida-ne'e nu'udar peste boot liu, la gosta todan husi ninia prezensa, laran-triste bainhira monu ba ninia influénsia, no hakarak tebes atu hetan libertasaun kompletu husi ida-ne'e. Sala la halo nia kontente tan; ida-ne'e sai ona buat ida ne'ebé nakdedar no nia odi. Maibé nia la bele halakon ninia prezensa iha ninia laran. Se nia dehan katak nia la iha sala, nia bosok hela (1 João 1:8). Maibé nia bele dehan katak nia odi sala no hakarak boot husi ninia klamar mak atu la halo sala hotu.
cards.key_takeaway_en: A born-again believer hates and fights against sin rather than practicing it habitually, even while wrestling with indwelling corruption.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Fiar-na'in ne'ebé moris foun odi no funu hasoru sala duké halo ho habitualmente, maski luta ho korrupsaun iha laran.

cards.scripture_en: "Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God" (1 John 5:1). "There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus" (Rom 8:1).
cards.scripture_tet: "Ema hotu ne'ebé fiar katak Jesus mak Kristu moris husi Maromak" (1 João 5:1). "Tanba ne'e agora la iha kondenasaun ba sira ne'ebé iha Kristu Jesus" (Roma 8:1).
cards.body_en: Second, John wrote: “Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God” (1 John 5:1). A man who is born again, or regenerated, believes that Jesus Christ is the only Saviour who can pardon his soul, that He is the divine Person appointed by God the Father for this very purpose, and beside Him there is no Saviour at all. In himself he sees nothing but unworthiness. But he has full confidence in Christ, and trusting in Him, he believes that his sins are all forgiven. He believes that, for the sake of Christ’s finished work and death on the Cross, he is reckoned righteous in God’s sight, and he may look forward to death and judgment without alarm (Romans 4:20-5:1; 8:1). He may have fears and doubts. But ask him if he is willing to trust in anything instead of Christ, and see what he will say. Ask him if he will rest his hope of eternal life on his own goodness, his own works, his prayers, his minister, or his church, and listen to his reply.
cards.body_tet: Daruak, João hakerek: "Ema hotu ne'ebé fiar katak Jesus mak Kristu moris husi Maromak" (1 João 5:1). Ema ida ne'ebé moris foun ona, ka rejeneradu, fiar katak Jesus Kristu mak Salvador mesak ne'ebé bele perdua ninia klamar, katak Nia mak Pessoa divina ne'ebé Maromak Aman hili ba objetivu ida-ne'e rasik, no iha Nia leten la iha Salvador ida. Iha ninia aan rasik nia haree de'it la merese. Maibé nia iha konfiansa tomak iha Kristu, no hodi fiar iha Nia, nia fiar katak ninia sala hotu hetan perdaun. Nia fiar katak, tanba Kristu nia serbisu kompletu no mate iha Krús, nia sura nu'udar loos iha Maromak nia oin, no nia bele hateke ba mate no julgamentu sein tauk (Roma 4:20-5:1; 8:1). Nia bele iha tauk no dúvida. Maibé husu nia se nia hakarak atu fiar ba buat seluk iha Kristu nia fatin, no haree saida mak nia sei dehan. Husu nia se nia sei tau ninia esperansa moris rohan-laek nian iha ninia di'ak rasik, ninia hahalok rasik, ninia orasaun sira, ninia ministru, ka ninia igreja, no rona ninia resposta.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Regeneration rests sole confidence in Christ's finished cross-work and righteousness, refusing any other ground of salvation.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Rejenerasaun tau konfiansa mesak iha Kristu nia serbisu krús nian ne'ebé kompletu no justisa, hodi la simu razaun seluk ba salvasaun.

cards.scripture_en: "Every one that doeth righteousness is born of him" (1 John 2:29). "By the grace of God I am what I am" (1 Cor 15:10).
cards.scripture_tet: "Ema hotu ne'ebé halo justisa moris husi Nia" (1 João 2:29). "Tanba Maromak nia grasa ha'u mak ha'u agora" (1 Korintu 15:10).
cards.body_en: Third, John wrote: “Every one that doeth righteousness is born of him” (1 John 2:29). The man who is born again, or regenerated, is a holy man. He endeavors to live according to God’s will, to do the things that please God and to avoid the things that God hates. He wishes to continually look to Christ as his example as well as his Saviour, and to prove himself to be Christ’s friend by doing whatever He commands. He knows he is not perfect. He is painfully aware of his indwelling corruption. He finds an evil principle within himself that is constantly warring against grace and trying to draw him away from God. But he does not consent to it, though he cannot prevent its presence. Though he may sometimes feel so low that he questions whether or not he is a Christian at all, he will be able to say with John Newton, “I am not what I ought to be; I am not what I want to be; I am not what I hope to be in another world—but still I am not what I once used to be, and by the grace of God I am what I am.”
cards.body_tet: Datoluk, João hakerek: "Ema hotu ne'ebé halo justisa moris husi Nia" (1 João 2:29). Ema ne'ebé moris foun ona, ka rejeneradu, mak ema santu ida. Nia esforsu aan atu moris tuir Maromak nia hakarak, atu halo buat sira ne'ebé halo Maromak kontente no atu sees husi buat sira ne'ebé Maromak odi. Nia hakarak atu hateke nafatin ba Kristu nu'udar ninia ezemplu no mós ninia Salvador, no atu prova ninia aan nu'udar Kristu nia belun hodi halo buat hotu ne'ebé Nia haruka. Nia hatene katak nia la perfeitu. Nia hatene ho laran-moras kona-ba ninia korrupsaun iha laran. Nia hetan prinsípiu aat ida iha ninia aan rasik ne'ebé funu nafatin hasoru grasa no koko atu dada nia sees husi Maromak. Maibé nia la konkorda ho ida-ne'e, maski nia la bele hanetik ninia prezensa. Maski dala ruma nia bele sente kraik tebes to'o husu se nia sarani ida ka lae, nia sei bele dehan hamutuk ho John Newton, "Ha'u la'ós buat ne'ebé ha'u tenke sai; ha'u la'ós buat ne'ebé ha'u hakarak sai; ha'u la'ós buat ne'ebé ha'u hein iha mundu seluk—maibé nafatin ha'u la'ós buat ne'ebé ha'u uluk sai, no tanba Maromak nia grasa ha'u mak ha'u agora."
cards.key_takeaway_en: A regenerated life pursues God's will and obedience in grace rather than perfectionism, resisting inward sin.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Moris ne'ebé rejeneradu buka Maromak nia hakarak no obediénsia iha grasa duké perfeisionizmu, hodi kontra sala iha laran.

cards.scripture_en: "We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren" (1 John 3:14).
cards.scripture_tet: "Ita hatene katak ita liu ona husi mate ba moris, tanba ita hadomi maun-alin no feton-laen sira" (1 João 3:14).
cards.body_en: Fourth, John wrote: “We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren” (1 John 3:14). A man who is born again has a special love for all true disciples of Christ. Like his Father in heaven, he loves all men with a great general love, but he has a special love for those who share his faith in Christ. Like his Lord and Saviour, he loves the worst of sinners and could weep over them; but he has a peculiar love for those who are believers. He is never so much at home as when he is in their company. He feels they are all members of the same family. They are his fellow soldiers, fighting against the same enemy. They are his fellow travelers, journeying along the same road. He understands them, and they understand him. They may be very different from himself in many ways—in rank, in station and in wealth. But that does not matter. They are his Father’s sons and daughters and he cannot help loving them.
cards.body_tet: Dahaat, João hakerek: "Ita hatene katak ita liu ona husi mate ba moris, tanba ita hadomi maun-alin no feton-laen sira" (1 João 3:14). Ema ida ne'ebé moris foun ona iha domin espesiál ida ba dixípulu loos hotu Kristu nian. Hanesan ninia Aman iha lalehan, nia hadomi ema hotu ho domin jerál boot ida, maibé nia iha domin espesiál ba sira ne'ebé fahe ninia fiar iha Kristu. Hanesan ninia Na'i no Salvador, nia hadomi ema sala-na'in aat liu no bele tanis ba sira; maibé nia iha domin partikulár ba sira ne'ebé fiar-na'in. Nia nunka sente iha uma hanesan bainhira nia hamutuk ho sira. Nia sente katak sira hotu membru husi família ida de'it. Sira mak ninia maluk soldadu sira, funu hasoru inimigu ida de'it. Sira mak ninia maluk viajen-na'in sira, la'o iha dalan ida de'it. Nia komprende sira, no sira komprende nia. Sira bele diferente tebes husi nia iha dalan barak—iha pozisaun, estadu no rikusoin. Maibé ida-ne'e la importante. Sira mak ninia Aman nia oan-mane no oan-feto sira no nia la bele la hadomi sira.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Born-again believers share a distinct spiritual family bond and fellowship with fellow Christians across social lines.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Fiar-na'in sira ne'ebé moris foun fahe ligasaun família espirituál ne'ebé espesiál no komuñaun ho sarani seluk maski diferente pozisaun sosiál.

cards.scripture_en: "Whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world" (1 John 5:4).
cards.scripture_tet: "Buat hotu ne'ebé moris husi Maromak manán mundu" (1 João 5:4).
cards.body_en: Fifth, John wrote: “Whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world” (1 John 5:4). A man who is born again does not use the world’s opinion as his standard of right and wrong. He does not mind going against the world’s ways, ideas, and customs. What men think or say no longer concerns him. He overcomes the love of the world. He finds no pleasure in things which seem to bring happiness to most people. To him they seem foolish and unworthy of an immortal being. He loves God’s praise more than man’s praise. He fears offending God more than offending man. It is unimportant to him whether he is blamed or praised; his first aim is to please God.
cards.body_tet: Dalimak, João hakerek: "Buat hotu ne'ebé moris husi Maromak manán mundu" (1 João 5:4). Ema ida ne'ebé moris foun ona la uza mundu nia opiniaun nu'udar ninia padraun kona-ba loos no sala. Nia la preokupa atu kontra mundu nia dalan, ideia no kostume sira. Saida mak ema hanoin ka dehan la preokupa tan nia. Nia manán domin ba mundu. Nia la hetan ksolok iha buat sira ne'ebé haree hanesan lori ksolok ba ema barak. Ba nia sira haree hanesan beik no la merese ba kriatura imortál ida. Nia hadomi Maromak nia louvór liu fali ema nia louvór. Nia tauk atu halo Maromak hirus liu fali halo ema hirus. La importante ba nia se nia hetan sala ka louvór; ninia objetivu dahuluk mak atu halo Maromak kontente.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Overcoming the world means prioritizing God's approval and pleasure over worldly opinions, pleasures, and praise.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Manán mundu signifika tau prioridade ba Maromak nia aprovasaun no ksolok duké opiniaun, ksolok no louvór mundanu sira.

cards.section_heading_tet: Sinál Daneen - Rai Aan Rasik Moos (Puru)
cards.scripture_en: "He that is begotten of God keepeth himself" (1 John 5:18).
cards.scripture_tet: "Ema ne'ebé moris husi Maromak rai ninia aan rasik" (1 João 5:18).
cards.body_en: Sixth, John wrote: “He that is begotten of God keepeth himself” (1 John 5:18). A man who is born again is careful of his own soul. He tries not only to avoid sin but also to avoid everything which may lead to it. He is careful about the company he keeps. He knows that evil communications corrupt the heart, and that evil is more catching than good, just as disease is more infectious than health. He is careful about the use of his time; his chief desire is to spend it profitably. He desires to live like a soldier in an enemy country—to wear his armor continually and to be prepared for temptation. He is diligent to be a watchful, humble, prayerful man.
cards.body_tet: Daneen, João hakerek: "Ema ne'ebé moris husi Maromak rai ninia aan rasik" (1 João 5:18). Ema ida ne'ebé moris foun ona kuidadu ninia klamar rasik. Nia koko la'ós de'it atu sees husi sala maibé mós atu sees husi buat hotu ne'ebé bele lori ba ida-ne'e. Nia kuidadu kona-ba maluk sira ne'ebé nia hamutuk. Nia hatene katak liafuan aat sira estraga fuan, no katak aat hada'et lalais liu fali di'ak, hanesan moras hada'et liu fali saúde. Nia kuidadu kona-ba uza ninia tempu; ninia hakarak prinsipál mak atu uza ida-ne'e ho benefísiu. Nia hakarak atu moris hanesan soldadu ida iha rai inimigu nian—atu hatais ninia armadura nafatin no preparadu ba tentasaun. Nia badinas atu sai ema ne'ebé vijilante, haraik-aan no iha orasaun.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Guarding one's soul means watching over company, time, and temptation like a vigilant soldier in prayer and humility.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Kuidade klamar rasik signifika vijila kona-ba maluk, tempu no tentasaun hanesan soldadu vijilante ida iha orasaun no haraik-aan.

cards.scripture_en: "Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith" (2 Cor 13:5).
cards.scripture_tet: "Ezamina imi-nia aan rasik, se imi iha fiar laran ka lae" (2 Korintu 13:5).
cards.body_en: These are the six great marks of a born again Christian. There is a vast difference in the depth and distinctness of these marks in different people. In some they are faint and hardly noticeable. In others they are bold, plain, and unmistakable, so anyone may read them. Some of these marks are more visible than others in each individual. Seldom are all equally evident in any one person. But still, after every allowance, here we find boldly painted six marks of being born of God. How should we react to these things? We can logically come to only one conclusion—only those who are born again have these six characteristics, and those who do not have these marks are not born again. This seems to be the conclusion to which the apostle intended us to come. Do you have these characteristics? Are you born again?
cards.body_tet: Sira-ne'e mak sinál boot neen husi sarani ida ne'ebé moris foun. Iha diferensa boot iha kle'an no klaridade husi sinál sira-ne'e iha ema oioin. Iha ema balun sira fraku no kuaze la haree. Iha ema seluk sira forte, klaru no la bele sala, atu ema hotu bele lee. Sinál balun husi sira-ne'e haree liu fali seluk iha indivíduu ida-idak. Raru liu mak hotu-hotu sai evidente hanesan iha ema ida. Maibé nafatin, hafoin konsidera hotu, iha ne'e ita hetan sinál neen ne'ebé pinta ho klaru kona-ba moris husi Maromak. Oinsá mak ita tenke reaje ba buat sira-ne'e? Ita bele to'o de'it ba konkluzaun ida tuir lójika—ema sira ne'ebé moris foun de'it mak iha karakterístika neen sira-ne'e, no sira ne'ebé la iha sinál sira-ne'e la moris foun. Ida-ne'e mak konkluzaun ne'ebé apóstolu hakarak ita atu to'o ba. Ó iha karakterístika sira-ne'e ka lae? Ó moris foun ona ka lae?
cards.key_takeaway_en: Examine your heart against the six scriptural marks of regeneration, recognizing that degrees vary while the reality is essential.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Ezamina ó-nia fuan tuir sinál bíbliku neen kona-ba rejenerasaun, hodi rekoñese katak grau diferente maibé realidade esensiál.

infographic.title_en: Six Biblical Marks of Being Born Again
infographic.title_tet: Sinál Bíbliku Neen Kona-Ba Moris Foun

items.desc_en: Hates and resists sin rather than living in it (1 John 3:9).
items.desc_tet: Odi no kontra sala duké moris iha laran (1 João 3:9).

items.desc_en: Relies solely on Christ's cross and righteousness (1 John 5:1).
items.desc_tet: Depende mesak ba Kristu nia krús no justisa (1 João 5:1).

items.desc_en: Pursues God's will and obedience by grace (1 John 2:29).
items.desc_tet: Buka Maromak nia hakarak no obediénsia iha grasa (1 João 2:29).

items.desc_en: Cherishes fellow believers as spiritual family (1 John 3:14).
items.desc_tet: Hadomi maluk fiar-na'in sira nu'udar família espirituál (1 João 3:14).

items.desc_en: Values God's approval above worldly ways and praise (1 John 5:4).
items.desc_tet: Folin-boot liu Maromak nia aprovasaun duké mundu (1 João 5:4).

items.desc_en: Guards soul, company, time, and temptation vigilantly (1 John 5:18).
items.desc_tet: Kuidadu klamar, maluk, tempu no tentasaun ho vijilánsia (1 João 5:18).
